task_description: Conduct anti-surface warfare operations including coordinated air, surface, and subsurface attacks against adversary naval forces.
evaluation_notes: Demonstrated during Day 4 strike operations. Strike Package Alpha achieved 75% of planned effects against adversary SAG. Multi-axis coordination effective.

task_description: Detect, track, classify, and engage adversary submarine threats. Includes ASW barrier operations, prosecution, and area sanitization.
evaluation_notes: Partially practiced during convoy operations. Submarine contact on Day 5 handled correctly (avoidance) but no prosecution attempted. Limited ASW exercise opportunities due to scenario focus on surface warfare.

task_description: Plan and execute amphibious assault and sustainment operations including ship-to-shore movement and naval surface fire support.
evaluation_notes: Not exercised during Pacific Strategy AY26 due to scenario constraints. 3rd MEF ARG capabilities not tested in amphibious role. Last evaluated during Talisman Sabre 2025.

task_description: Provide layered air and missile defense across the operational area. Includes early warning, threat identification, engagement authority, and BDA.
evaluation_notes: Demonstrated throughout exercise. CAP Delta maintained 94.4% availability over 72 hours. 12 adversary contacts detected, 3 successful intercepts. E-2D integration effective.

task_description: Conduct electronic attack, electronic protection, and electronic warfare support operations in contested electromagnetic environment.
evaluation_notes: Improving but gaps remain. EA-18G EW support effective during strike operations but adversary GPS spoofing and comms jamming exceeded pre-exercise estimates. Counter-EW TTPs improvised rather than pre-planned.

task_description: Conduct maritime interdiction including visit, board, search, and seizure (VBSS) and enforcement of maritime exclusion zones.
evaluation_notes: Demonstrated during Day 22 operations following FRAGO 001 shift to maritime interdiction. Exclusion zone enforcement effective. VBSS teams conducted 4 compliant boardings.

task_description: Coordinate and execute joint fires including air-to-surface, surface-to-surface, and naval surface fire support across component boundaries.
evaluation_notes: Coordination challenges noted during Day 4 strike. ROE confirmation delays at division level caused 45-minute gap. Fire authority delegation resolved issue but highlighted systemic coordination friction.

task_description: Protect personnel, equipment, and facilities from threats including physical security, CBRN defense, and operational security.
evaluation_notes: Sustained performance throughout exercise. Immediate ROE compliance when adversary entered neutral waters. Force protection posture transitions executed within 2 minutes of threat detection during convoy operations.

task_description: Collect, process, analyze, and disseminate intelligence across the joint force. Includes ISR management, targeting support, and intelligence sharing.
evaluation_notes: ISR feed latency exceeded 5-minute threshold during critical engagement windows. Intelligence dissemination lag of 36 hours between J2 assessment and logistics planning cell. BDA delayed by 2 hours post-strike.

task_description: Plan and execute sustainment operations including supply, maintenance, transportation, and health services across the operational area.
evaluation_notes: UNREP operations executed effectively when alongside but fuel consumption planning factors underestimated by 15% for contested environment. VLS ammunition transfer deferred due to sea state. Supply chain stress visible by Day 10.

task_description: Conduct combined operations with allied and partner forces including communications interoperability, information sharing, and combined tactical procedures.
evaluation_notes: JASDF F-35B integration partially successful (2 of 3 combined patrols). Link-16 message standard differences caused cancellation of third patrol. Communications interoperability challenges with partner nations remain persistent issue.

task_description: Plan and execute strategic communications and information operations to shape the operational environment and support campaign objectives.
evaluation_notes: Not exercised during Pacific Strategy AY26. Strategic communications component not included in exercise design. Recommend inclusion in future exercises.
